mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attachment (board_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_size, created_at) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, board_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_size, created_at FROM attachment WHERE board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY id ASC
